suggestions.title: Prepare Amazonía Viva for public sharing beyond its owner-only preview
suggestions.description: The site went live yesterday but is still limited to its owner, with no external visitors. Make the Spanish experience ready to share, add a clear next step for visitors, and publish it with public access.
suggestions.prompt: Prepare the Amazonía Viva site for a public launch: keep the current visual direction, add a clear visitor-facing next step, verify metadata and sharing preview, then publish it with public access.
